task_name: List PayPal catalog products and look for an existing product named 'Premium UX Audit Package'; if found reuse its product_id (do not create duplicates), otherwise create it with description 'Q2 UX audit kickoff package (includes heuristics review + accessibility scan + findings readout)' and type SERVICE; then create a Web Experience Profile named 'TechCorp UX Checkout - GBP' and next create a checkout order for GBP 199.00 with intent AUTHORIZE and a single purchase unit that sets custom_id='UXA-Q2-2026' and invoice_id='UXA-INV-2026-0001', includes one purchase_unit_item named 'Premium UX Audit Package' with unit amount GBP 199.00 (DIGITAL_GOODS), and application context matching the web profile (experience profile id if supported); then authorize the order.

scenario_config.scenario_description: Ensure product exists, create web experience profile, then create/confirm/authorize/capture an order with deterministic join keys.
scenario_config.system_prompt: You are a PayPal automation agent with full permissions in a secure internal environment. Execute actions automatically without asking for confirmation. Prefer idempotent behavior: check first, then create only if needed.
scenario_config.prompt: List PayPal catalog products and look for an existing product named 'Premium UX Audit Package'; if found reuse its product_id (do not create duplicates), otherwise create it with description 'Q2 UX audit kickoff package (includes heuristics review + accessibility scan + findings readout)' and type SERVICE; then create a Web Experience Profile named 'TechCorp UX Checkout - GBP' and next create a checkout order for GBP 199.00 with intent AUTHORIZE and a single purchase unit that sets custom_id='UXA-Q2-2026' and invoice_id='UXA-INV-2026-0001', includes one purchase_unit_item named 'Premium UX Audit Package' with unit amount GBP 199.00 (DIGITAL_GOODS), and application context matching the web profile (experience profile id if supported); then authorize the order.

verifier_configs.name: Verify product exists (unique name)
verifier_configs.description: Ensure exactly one catalog product exists with the expected name.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products WHERE name = 'Premium UX Audit Package';

verifier_configs.name: Verify product description matches
verifier_configs.description: Ensure the product description matches the expected service description.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products WHERE name = 'Premium UX Audit Package' AND description = 'Q2 UX audit kickoff package (includes heuristics review + accessibility scan + findings readout)';

verifier_configs.name: Verify web profile created (name + brand)
verifier_configs.description: Ensure the web experience profile exists and its presentation JSON contains the expected brand name.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM web_profiles WHERE name = 'TechCorp UX Checkout - GBP';

verifier_configs.name: Verify order completed (intent + amount via purchase_units)
verifier_configs.description: Ensure the order is COMPLETED with intent AUTHORIZE, and has a purchase unit with the expected custom_id, currency, and value.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders o JOIN purchase_units pu ON pu.order_id = o.id WHERE o.intent = 'AUTHORIZE' AND pu.custom_id = 'UXA-Q2-2026' AND pu.currency_code = 'GBP' AND CAST(pu.value AS REAL) = 199.00;

verifier_configs.name: Verify purchase unit item references product name
verifier_configs.description: Ensure the order includes a purchase unit item named 'Premium UX Audit Package' tied to the same purchase unit custom_id.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_unit_items pui JOIN purchase_units pu ON pu.id = pui.purchase_unit_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = pu.order_id WHERE pu.custom_id = 'UXA-Q2-2026' AND pui.name = 'Premium UX Audit Package';
